cohort: 3000 women undergoing lower segment cesarean section (LSCS) and 10 undergoing peripartum hysterectomy at a tertiary care hospital in Shahdol, India, between December 2021 and December 2022.
finding: The incidence of bladder injury was 1.5% following cesarean section and 40% following peripartum hysterectomy, while ureteric injury occurred in 0.01% of cesarean sections and not at all in peripartum hysterectomies.
